issues.detail: Section1.4 missing-section row and E5 incorrectly null DISPUTED when evidenceGaps fails. Accepted R2 derives DISPUTED from condition own-axis evaluation. If own evaluation succeeds with 2 disputed subjects, evidenceGaps failure gives EVIDENCE_GAP=null, DISPUTED=2, completeness=INCOMPLETE. Preserve the accepted R2 source map.

A (revision,component,code) key permits multiple null-component rows for different codes, contradicting section1.4 implicit example/E3 no-two-null-rows wording. UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT is on (evidence_id,criterion_revision_id,component_key), not a one-claim/one-row limit per revision.
For the same component the declared vocabulary order puts PENDING_REVIEW before REJECTED, but section1.3 shows REJECTED first and E1 asserts exact order.

The recommendation is component-by-gap-code, not one row per distinct component. A component can increase total more than once; component+code identity changes when the failure code changes. Disclose count/identity/consumer implications, compare the component-only blueprint alternative, and do not call this field-shape-only compatibility.

The derivation text says Requirements/Actions always have verification, but approved applicability makes Action verification conditional on proof_required. The later proof_required=false exclusion must govern; do not fabricate a verification axis.

The 33-operation option is a disclosed partial-pagination/risk-acceptance alternative. A page with just one submission can still carry arbitrary N submittedVersionRefs; a cycle item can still carry arbitrary receipt/outcome refs. limit<=200 limits row count, not nested array length or response bytes. The constant-size-item claim in section2.3 is false; no PO risk acceptance is recorded.

counterexample.conclusion: payload grows with N/M although outer page row count is fixed

issues.detail: Cycle example dueAt is date-only while candidate responses require explicit instants/offsets. outcomeEvidenceRefs:null needs an explicit empty-versus-unavailable meaning; do not silently treat known empty as unknown.

Absence of a per-cycle UNIQUE means the current candidate schema permits multiple submissions. It does not by itself prove an approved RULE-012 requirement that every such resubmission/correction is legal or that a new domain bound is forbidden; any restriction remains a real model/policy decision.

The printed follow-up SHA differs by one nibble. Codex reverified the intended current inputs; the reviewer must correct the printed value or provide bounded command evidence. This is not proof that wrong bytes were read, and not an independently attested reviewer execution.
There are 21 content inputs (2+19) plus 3 manifests (1+2), hence 24 physical files. The report labels their sum as 21.

qa.original_review_text: - **Q1 Uniform missing/non-member responses incl. revoked cursors — RESOLVED_IN_REVIEWED_CANDIDATE.** Ambiguity: 404 vs 422 for a revoked member's still-valid cursor. Exact source: RC-1 (check order), RC-3, RC-6; approved permission-matrix sensitive-denial and revocation-recheck rules. Answer: byte-identical 404 for non-member, nonexistent, foreign and kind-mismatched ids and for a revoked caller presenting a valid cursor (membership precedes cursor validation); no 403 on reads. Smallest correction: none; optionally add the cursor-after-revocation example line. Owner: none (documented) / Codex intake.

- **Q2 Partial section failure within the single overview boundary — RESOLVED_IN_REVIEWED_CANDIDATE.** Ambiguity: what distinguishes section failure reasons. Source: READ-02; FR-009 approved error behavior; AC-156 approved distinguishability. Answer: root 200 with per-section availability; UNAVAILABLE+null; null counts never 0; condition INCOMPLETE; STALE client-only; 503 only for snapshot-open failure or zero available sections. Correction: F-02 (code vocabulary). Owner: Claude.

- **Q3 Shared overview revision; newer pages labeled, not merged — RESOLVED_IN_REVIEWED_CANDIDATE.** Ambiguity: none material. Source: READ-02, addendum snapshot semantics, NAV rules. Answer: every continuation/detail response is its own boundary with its own asOf/sourceRevision, labeled "changed since overview" when newer, never merged; point lookups never patch the overview. Correction: none.

- **Q4 Complete cursor reachability and actor/Matter binding — RESOLVED_IN_REVIEWED_CANDIDATE (F-01 open).** Source: RC-6/RC-7 + the section/continuation order-equality invariant. Answer: yes for the seven paginated sections via their named routes; opaque cursors bound to actor/matter/collection/filter/sort; mismatch → 422 without detail; revoked → 404. Correction: F-01 for the DR-06 two-sided envelope. Owner: Claude.

- **Q5 Exact assessment/submission versions after promotion — ANSWERED_FROM_APPROVED_SOURCE.** Source: approved RULE-011 and AC-128; contract reference rules make it wire-level. Answer: exact `assessedDocumentVersionRef`, `submittedVersionRefs`, `criterionRevisionRef`, `submissionId` are retained; the current pointer is never substituted (NAV-07); fixed-version criteria unaffected. Correction: none.

- **Q6 AtlasT0 empty Next Actions and RQ-04 root-cause visibility — RESOLVED_IN_REVIEWED_CANDIDATE (F-03/F-11 open).** Source: approved RULE-021, READ-02 `excluded[]`, dependency-engine §5/§7, blockers rootCause rule. Answer: `items: []` explained by `excluded[]`; no Requirements, no invented work; RQ-04 appears as root-cause blocker card (WAITING+READY, failing DEP-01); no metric invented. Corrections: F-03 (reason precedence), F-11 (critical designation). Owners: Claude / Codex.

- **Q7 No domain-history/verification mutation or payload logging on reads — RESOLVED_IN_REVIEWED_CANDIDATE.** Ambiguity: whether denial-audit is a "mutation". Source: RC-9, ADR-002 §1.6 (reads never write), approved permission-matrix audit rule, FR-008. Answer: reads create no domain event, verification or history; the only write is the approved restricted security audit on denial; no tokens/payloads in logs; security audit never appears in DR-15 events. - **Q8 Uniform not-found for kind-mismatched resource IDs — RESOLVED_IN_REVIEWED_CANDIDATE (F-05 adjacent).** Source: RC-3, addendum authorization blocks, CT-05. Answer: an Action id on `/requirements/{id}`, a claimId on `/evidence/{id}`, an edgeRef on `/nodes/{id}` all return the same byte-identical 404. Correction: F-05 pins the separate malformed-id case.
